title: Adoption Rate and Effectiveness of ScamShield in Preventing Scams
what_it_is: Adoption Rate and Effectiveness of ScamShield in Preventing Scams

sections.label: ScamShield downloads count
sections.summary: As of October 2023, there have been about 750,000 downloads.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As of October 2023, there have been about 750,000 downloads.

sections.label: ScamShield blacklisting and SMS flagging
sections.summary: Since March 2022, ScamShield and related efforts blacklisted about 80,000 scam-tainted numbers and flagged about five million SMSes as potential scams.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Since March 2022, about 80,000 unique scam-tainted phone numbers have been blacklisted and blocked by ScamShield and about five million SMSes have been flagged to users as potential scams.

sections.label: Online Criminal Harms Act operationalisation
sections.summary: The Online Criminal Harms Act will be operationalised progressively from the first quarter of 2024 and will let the Police tackle online scam activities more effectively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Online Criminal Harms Act, which will be operationalised progressively from the first quarter of 2024, will allow the Police to tackle online scam activities more effectively.

sections.label: Decision not to pre-load ScamShield
sections.summary: The government decided not to pre-load ScamShield, partly because users could deactivate or delete it, but will keep the option open if download efforts do not progress.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the first question about pre-loading ScamShield, we have considered this before, but we have decided not to proceed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Thirdly, there is always a possibility that mobile users could deactivate or delete the app after we pre-load it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, for these considerations, we decided not to pre-load the ScamShield app, but we will keep this option open if our efforts to further encourage the download of the ScamShield app does not make progress.

sections.label: Telcos blocking scam calls
sections.summary: Telcos blocked 180 million scam calls at the network level in the first half of 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But, as we know, there are other stakeholders who are involved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I have talked about how the telcos at the network level have effectively blocked 180 million scam calls at their level in the first half of 2023.

sections.label: Feedback on ScamShield background operation
sections.summary: A feedback received is that users are not aware if the ScamShield app is actually working in the background of their phones.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For instance, a feedback we have received is that users are not aware if the ScamShield app is actually working in the background of their phones.

sections.label: In-app scam reporting improvements
sections.summary: Potential improvements to in-app reporting of malicious calls and SMSes aim to make ScamShield more user-friendly, avoiding copy-paste and extra steps.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Other potential improvements are about in-app reporting of malicious calls and SMSes to make it more user-friendly for users of ScamShield to be able to use it, rather than have to copy and paste the scam messages and to have additional steps when it comes to reporting.

sections.label: CPF scam prevention measures
sections.summary: Other stakeholders like the CPF Board announced default daily withdrawal limits and the CPF withdrawal lock to prevent scam-related money losses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: You would also have read that there are other stakeholders such as the Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board, which has recently announced the default daily withdrawal limits, the CPF withdrawal lock, so on and so forth – all of which are other ways to prevent our population, our society and our members from losing their monies through scams.
